title: Sunday · a third of a page, ii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The tavern roof again — 2004's second Sunday — redrawn to the smaller grid. The same composition, a third the size, the tiers thinner, the gulls fewer because there isn't room.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the tavern's roof from the garage window, the composition of dw_2004-04-18, but the tier is short and the roof crowds it. Three gulls where there were seven.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a tavern's shingle roof seen from a garage window with three gulls on the ridge, the composition cramped into a shallow strip, no words
image.notes: Draw this page at a third of the Sunday's height; the reader can measure it against 2004.

panels.name: Roof

panels.composition: Tier 2: one gull, close, the only thing that fits.
